question: How does pure knowledge serve awakening, asleep and awake?
premises: unawakened pure knowledge becomes the saviors' instrument
awakened pure knowledge carries its own refinement
inference: Pure knowledge is instrumental throughout, refined when awake.
uncertainties: santrnam (saviors/protectors) kept per gloss; prabubhutsu subject open
plain_english: Yearning to awake, pure knowledge becomes the saviors' instrument; awakened, pure knowledge is joined with its own refinement.
